title: What changed in AI tools — September 2026
summary: A public keep/cut digest of recorded vendor launches and directory checks this month. World Labs published Atlas on 2026-09-01 as an early-access omni world model with no public self-serve pricing, so it is a watch item rather than a directory listing.

vendor_launches.name: Atlas (World Labs)
vendor_launches.note: Official blog (checked 2026-09-01): next-gen omni world model pretrained from scratch on text, images, video, and 3D. Multimodal autoregressive diffusion transformer with spatial context. Camera-controlled generation up to 1 minute at 1440p; spatial reconstruction from 1–dozens of images with explicit 3D (point clouds, 3D Gaussian splats); space-time simulation including video reframing and Real-to-Sim for robotics; also text-to-image and 360 panoramas. Will power future versions of Marble. Early access with select partners — request access on the blog. No public self-serve plan prices published.

keep_cut_rule: If a launch has no public pricing, do not treat it as a buy decision. Watch the official source until self-serve plans exist, then re-check before adding a seat.

watch_list.name: Claude
watch_list.note: Sonnet/Opus point releases plus Claude Code as a coding surface. Do not assume the chat plan and the coding workflow are the same job.

keep_cut_rule: If two paid tools own the same weekly job, keep one. Use a real task test, then cancel the extra seat before renewal.
